question:
Choose the best synonym for the word "trigger" in the sentence:

"The cue is the trigger that tells your brain to go into automatic mode."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. initiator.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"trigger"** means:

 
 
• An event or situation that causes something to start; something that sets off a process or initiates an action. (ट्रिगर)
 
 
 
• In the sentence provided, "The cue is the trigger that tells your brain to go into automatic mode," "trigger" implies something that initiates or starts the brain's automatic response.
 
• **Initiator** means a person or thing that initiates someone or something. (आरंभकर्ता)
 
• **Example:** The initiator of the movement was awarded for their efforts.

Therefore, the best synonym for "trigger" in the given sentence is: **initiator.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options and their meanings:

 
• **Barrier** (बाधा): A fence or other obstacle that prevents movement or access.

 
 
• **Example:** The barrier blocked the entrance to the restricted area.
 
 
 
• **Obstacle** (अवरोध): A thing that blocks one's way or prevents or hinders progress.
 
 
• **Example:** The construction work created an obstacle on the road.
 
 
 
• **Conclusion** (निष्कर्ष): The end or finish of an event, process, or text.
 
 
• **Example:** The conclusion of the meeting was very productive.
